blind.description: A stylized potted plant featuring large, fan-shaped green leaves growing out of dark soil in a rounded terracotta pot. The pot has a bright green band around its lower half and a warm orange-brown upper rim and neck. The leaves are thick and cartoonish with scalloped, finger-like segments, branching from small central stems. All surfaces are smooth, continuous, and solid with no floating, melted, or broken geometry.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a cluster of fan-like, notched green leaves radiating outward around a small central pot with visible brown soil.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2 ft tall) and about as wide as it is tall.
